name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, rest a barbell across your front shoulders, and grip it just outside shoulder width with vertical forearms.
Squeeze your glutes, brace your abs tightly, and tuck your chin slightly back to clear the bar path.
Press the bar straight overhead until your elbows lock out and the bar balances directly over your midfoot.
Lower the bar smoothly down in front of your face back to your front shoulders.
tips: Keep your knees straight and glutes squeezed so you do not turn the strict press into a push press.
Keep your ribs down rather than leaning far back to force the bar up.
